title: Enforce salesperson data scope for customers and sales documents
description: Add reusable server-side data-scope enforcement so restricted salespeople can only view their assigned customers and related sales documents while privileged roles retain existing access.
acceptance_criteria: Customer, inquiry, quotation, PI, sales-order, shipment and invoice queries share one explicit data-scope policy.
Detail and export endpoints fail closed when the user is outside scope, not only list endpoints.
Administrators and explicitly privileged roles retain their current authorized access.
Release build and focused unit tests pass.
